About

I'm a marketing and project manager who ends up owning the whole thing end-to-end — the strategy, the partnership calls, the event floor, and the numbers afterward. Over 4+ years working inside fast-growing startups (WeStride, Gowabi, Yindii) in EdTech and e-commerce, I've scaled revenue, cut acquisition costs, and run corporate partnerships and live events without handing pieces of the work to someone else to finish.
